nodes.description:
**The seed.** A repository under discovery has no model yet, so exactly one node
is authored: the repository itself, as an `Artifact`.

Discovery is then a plan applied to it, using the existing Director unchanged —
which is the claim `ADR-0105` makes and this project exists to test.
